build_dotsocr_causal_lm: build a DotsOCRForCausalLM multimodal model with vision tower and language model for document OCR inference
create_vision_transformer: create a DotsVisionTransformer with patch embedding, attention blocks, and rotary positional embeddings for image processing
test_dummy_inputs_builder: test the DotsOCRDummyInputsBuilder that generates dummy text and image data for model initialization
run_image_embedding_pipeline: run the _process_image_input pipeline to convert pixel values or image embeddings through the vision transformer
load_model_weights: load weights into DotsOCRForCausalLM using AutoWeightsLoader with HF-to-vLLM weight mapping
